rule.sentence: Turns whose prompt cache was rebuilt: the cached prefix collapsed and was re-created in the same turn.

Conversations with at most 3 human turns where at least one request used at least 80% of that request's model context window. With several replies the largest single request fraction is used, never their sum.
Cost attributable to delegated subagent work, grouped by parent. On Codex this is an identifiable subset of unknown completeness.

constants.turnDefinition: Turn definition: main-thread human messages only — non-sidechain, non-subagent, after command and meta normalisation; assistant replies associate with the nearest preceding human.

notes.overlap: The classes overlap — one session is also a project and a model — so shares do not sum to 100 percent.
notes.scope: This explains locally retained cost and tokens, not quota percentage.
